atlas_derivative_of.author: Andreas F. Borchert

sources.changes: Original mesh and atlas UV preserved; translation-only grounded pivot. Legacy Blender-Internal material restored to Principled using unchanged author's diffuse/normal atlas bytes. Auto-smooth compatibility node removed. Roughness absent: explicit 0.92 constant. No generated floor. Atlas and derived normal redistributed under CC BY-SA 3.0, attribution retained.

sources.title: 3TD Fantasy Ruins Pack for Blender
sources.author: Ron Kapaun / 3 Tier Digital Studios; Blender conversion by velocirection
sources.changes: NorthAfricanRuins retains native arch/corner/broken pillar mesh UV and packed maps, uniformly scaled 0.55 and rigidly assembled. These are older abandoned stone ruins surviving in the setting, not newly built 16th-century architecture. MiddleEasternCourtyard uses native broken wall/L-corner modules and selected WoodDebris17 faces; new user-authorized U-shaped clay courtyard design with two self-intersection-aware Boolean windows and slight bevel on new design only. No decimation or Unity refitting.

sources.title: Clay Plaster
sources.author: Amal Kumar / Poly Haven
sources.changes: Original 1k PNG bytes retained. Authored metric UV0 uses source 2 m tile; native wall UV backed up separately. Weathered lower clay reuses these images with explicit linear tint [0.48,0.39,0.30,1]. Timber UV0 remains original author atlas. No fabricated AO or roughness maps.

source_policy: Only the formal category .blend and test exports are authoritative derivatives; ignored raw downloads and review files are not the master. All used images are packed in the formal .blend. Mixed licenses must never be described collectively as CC0.
